title: A Litre of Tears (2005) Trailer English Subtitles (1リットルの涙　予告編　英語字幕)
description: Based on Aya Kito (July 19, 1962 – May 23, 1988)'s memoir, 1 Litre no Namida. Aya Kito, a 9th grader, collapses on the way to school. Dr. Yamamoto discovers that Aya has spinocerebellar ataxia, a fatal and incurable disease that handicaps the body. Aya's mother, Shioka Kito, and Dr. Yamamoto encourage Aya to record her days in a diary to tell her story and to live her life to the fullest.
